name: Udangudi Supercritical Thermal Power Project Stage I
aliases: Udangudi Thermal Power Project Stage I

fuel.grade_or_kind: 50:50 imported:domestic (fresh EC 2026); GCV 4350 kcal/kg; SCCL bridge linkage for domestic coal
route: sea: -> Udangudi captive coal jetty (1.2 km)

water.cooling: cooling towers with seawater make-up (blowdown discharged to sea)

evacuation: 400 kV DC Udangudi STPP - Ottapidaram (completed; start-up power)

emissions.fgd: not required (SO2 category C per MoEF 11.07.2025)
emissions.notes: ESP for PM<30 mg/Nm3, low-NOx burners

history: Announced 2013 (EC 2013 for 2x800 MW imported coal, amended 2017 to 2x660). Main plant BHEL 07.12.2017, coal jetty ITD Cementation 13.02.2018. ~95.6% physical progress; fresh EC 02.03.2026; expected U1 Jan-2026/U2 May-2026 (slipping). Stage II and III (2x660 each) and a new 1x800 MW unit on the same land are planned.
